name: ActionMenu
description: `ActionMenu` is a composable Base UI menu with button and low-level trigger options.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line. Defaults to wrapping within `Dialog.Footer`.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Loading status text. Set to an empty string when an external announcer communicates loading.

props.name: notificationIndicator
props.description:
Shows a dot for new activity on the button boundary or on the leading visual. `leadingVisual` requires a
`leadingVisual`. The dot is not announced, so describe the activity in the accessible name or description.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the button.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Trailing visual for the trigger; pass `null` to remove it.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior. Use `submit` to submit a form.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the button. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the content along the anchor's edge.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift in pixels along the anchor's edge, or a callback that computes it from the measured sizes.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Positions the content against this anchor instead of the trigger, such as an element rendered elsewhere.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description:
How the menu avoids collisions on the side and alignment axes. Horizontal menus fall back to the perpendicular
axis by default when neither horizontal side fits.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: Element or rectangle used to constrain the menu's position.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Space to keep between the menu and its collision boundary.

props.name: container
props.type: HTMLElement | RefObject<HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null> | ShadowRoot | null
props.description: Portal destination. Pass `null` to wait for a container; ignored when `portal` is false.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the surface.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Largest height the surface may grow to before its content scrolls.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Largest width the surface may grow to.

props.name: portal
props.description: Where the content is rendered in the DOM. Set `false` to keep it in place.

props.name: positionerClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the element that positions the content.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: CSS positioning method for the positioner.

props.name: preventFocusOnClose
props.description: If true, focus will not be returned to the trigger or `finalFocus` target when the menu closes.

props.name: showDividers
props.description: Draws a divider between consecutive items.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the menu opens on. Menus open below their trigger, and submenus beside it.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the content and its anchor, or a callback that computes it.

props.name: variant
props.description:
How the menu is presented at each viewport range. `{narrow: 'fullscreen'}` covers narrow viewports and adds a
close button.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the surface.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the item temporarily unavailable and explains why.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the leading visual, or the trailing visual when there is none, and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the item is loading.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the item as the current choice.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `danger` for a destructive action.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether activating the link closes the menu, as activating any other menu item does.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the link temporarily unavailable and explains why. The link renders as an inactive item until it is available.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `danger` for a destructive navigation.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description:
Whether toggling the item closes the menu, as activating any other menu item does. Set `false` to keep the menu
open while several items are toggled.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether choosing the item closes the menu, as activating any other menu item does.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the item temporarily unavailable and explains why.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the leading visual, or the trailing visual when there is none, and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the item is loading.

props.name: selected
props.description: Shows the current-choice indicator without changing selection when the submenu opens. Does not set an ARIA checked state.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `danger` for a destructive action.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clips the description to one line instead of wrapping.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the description sits beside the label or on its own line.
